provider: Tripo Studio (logged-in browser), DCC Bridge -> Tripo3DUEBridge
purpose: Docs/ArtBacklog.md section B: B1 Aetheri monster race, B4 sabercat companion clips, B2 realistic quadrupeds, B5 props.

balanceLog.when: after 8 Aetheri rigs + dire wolf rig

pipelineNotes: Same as Art/TripoRaces.json pipelineNotes, plus: Send To is a hover menu on the Export dialog's 'Send To' button (pick 'Send To Unreal'); the DCC Bridge Unreal switch must be re-enabled after every page load (the first click in the popover is often swallowed, so check it says Connected).

Start the Bridge editor with -Multiprocess while other worktrees are building: otherwise its AutoSDK 'Build.bat -Mode=ValidatePlatforms' call queues behind the global Build.bat lock and startup hangs after 'Completed SDK detection'.
Integration: set CIRE_TRIPO_PENDING_ONLY=1 so Tools/IntegrateTripoRaces.py only touches units with a pending Bridge import (it now also reads this file).

sabercat.detail: The Studio's only quadruped preset ('Walk') still fails to retarget on the sabercat rig (no clip produced) and on a fresh neutral-stance Other rig (dire wolf: 'Invalid user input'). No other quadruped presets exist; text-to-motion failed in the previous batch. The pets agent drives the sabercat procedurally (Content/Data/PetArt.tripo.json).
